name: agent-sandbox-hardened-runtime-class

controlConfigInputs.name: Hardened sandbox runtime classes
controlConfigInputs.description: Approved runtimeClassName values for Sandbox and SandboxTemplate resources; a missing or empty list disables the check.

description: Checks Sandbox and SandboxTemplate runtimeClassName against hardenedSandboxRuntimeClasses; missing or empty configuration disables the check.
remediation: Set spec.podTemplate.spec.runtimeClassName to an approved hardened runtime such as gvisor.
